eventForm.brandHelp: The brand decides which landing page the event appears on.
eventForm.nameHelp: The public address is derived from the name unless another one is given.
eventForm.sizeChangeHelp: Until when the athlete can change their size on their own. Shirt production needs the cut before registrations close.
eventForm.reservationHelp: How long the spot is held for someone who has not paid yet, before it is released.
eventForm.toleranceHelp: How much less than the price is still accepted. At 0 the exact amount is required.
eventForm.liabilityHelp: The athlete accepts it when registering, and it is stored with the date and IP. The event cannot be published without this text.
eventForm.published: The event is published and now accepts registrations.
